clock.scope: one device/rank; AIC, AIV0, and AIV1 in the same physical AI Block share a synchronized clock; different AI Blocks may have a fixed offset and are normalized independently
clock.zero_handling: a sampled low-32 system-cycle value of zero is remapped to one so zero remains an unambiguous missing sentinel

comparison_group.label: AI Block
comparison_group.reason: AIC[i], AIV0[i], and AIV1[i] form one physical AI Block and share a synchronized timestamp; different AI Blocks are not compared by absolute x position

visualization.protocol_impact: grouping, per-Wave expert ordinals, and Chinese wording are host-only; compact route-index preparation, all physical AI Blocks, per-tile GMM1/SwiGLU/GMM2 sparse payloads, GMM1 gap diagnostics, AIV1 inter-Dispatch Scalar diagnostics, GMM2 activation-ready/FIX waits, pairwise Combine tile tasks, quantized 256-token Combine group tasks, and AIV post-Combine tail stages are protocol-v18 device ABI

protocol.record_order_description: AIC[0..aicNum-1], AIV0[0..aicNum-1], then AIV1[0..aicNum-1], each in ascending physical AI Block index
protocol.header_contract: 30 little-endian uint32 words; record_words=44 contains 30 fixed timestamps followed by fourteen sparse descriptors for seven stages, record_count=3*aicNum, capture_capacity is the per-stage per-core scratch segment capacity, repetition_count is the runtime GMM Wave count, truncated covers scratch or y compaction overflow, and magic is published last
protocol.flags_contract: bits[12:0] must equal 0x00001fff; bit12 identifies the PR10302 compact route-index and 256-token Combine group trace semantics; bit13 records MEGA_MOE_A8W8_DISPATCH_GROUP_READY

output.carrier: after normal BF16 y[bs,h] is complete, its bytes are reused for protocol-v18 fixed timestamps, sparse descriptors, and compact sparse segment payloads
output.capacity_check: host preflight proves descriptor and fixed workspace-scratch capacity; AIC0 computes the actual compact payload size after work_end, writes no out-of-bounds payload on overflow, sets truncated, and the default decoder rejects it
output.write_phase: each role appends only to its exclusive 50-MiB reserved-workspace slice during useful work; after work_end and y-lifetime rendezvous AIC0 plans offsets, role writers compact payloads, then AIC0 publishes header and magic last
output.rendezvous: three mixed AIC/AIV rendezvous occur only after work_end: protect normal y and summaries, publish descriptors, then publish payloads

points.semantics: 本卡所有 AIV 已完成 MoE 专家流水并通过 SyncAll。
points.perturbation: 每个 AIV 一次时钟读取。

dependency.proof: marker is immediately after the existing synchronization

points.scope: 每个 AIV 各一次；sharedExpertNum=0 时仅覆盖分支判断。
points.why: 显示 V 侧在共享专家 GMM2 调用路径上的调度区间。
points.semantics: 即将判断并按需进入共享专家 GMM2 helper；实际 Cube 计算仍由 AIC 完成。
points.perturbation: 每个 AIV 一次时钟读取。

dependency.proof: marker immediately precedes the sharedExpertNum branch on AIV roles

points.scope: 与 shared_expert_gmm2_begin_S 一一对应。
points.why: 区分共享专家调用开销与后续输出同步；共享结果等待可能继续落在 Unpermute 内。
points.semantics: AIV 角色已从共享专家 GMM2 helper 返回。
points.perturbation: 每个 AIV 一次时钟读取，不增加 Cube/FIX drain。

dependency.proof: no tracing-only completion event is inserted

points.scope: 所有 AIV 各一次。
points.why: 直接量化本 rank 等待其他 rank 完成 Combine 发送的时间。
points.semantics: 即将进入 Unpermute 前的输出跨 rank 同步。
points.perturbation: 每个 AIV 一次时钟读取。

dependency.proof: marker immediately precedes the output rank handshake

points.scope: 与 output_cross_rank_sync_begin_S 一一对应。
points.why: 把慢 rank 的 Combine 尾部与本地 Unpermute 分开。
points.semantics: 所有 rank 的输出握手已完成，本卡 Combine 接收区可读。
points.perturbation: 每个 AIV 一次时钟读取。

dependency.proof: marker is immediately after the existing cross-rank synchronization

points.scope: 所有 AIV 各一次。
points.why: 把 UB view/config 构造与 Unpermute 数据流水分开。
points.semantics: 即将构造当前 AIV 的 Unpermute buffer 视图。
points.perturbation: 每个 AIV 一次时钟读取。

dependency.proof: marker immediately precedes InitTokenUnpermuteBuffers

points.scope: 与 unpermute_init_begin_S 一一对应。
points.why: 识别极端配置下 buffer 规划本身是否异常。
points.semantics: Unpermute UB view 和当前 job bufferConfig 已构造完成。
points.perturbation: 每个 AIV 一次时钟读取。

dependency.proof: helper only constructs local tensor views and returns synchronously

points.scope: 所有 AIV 各一次。
points.why: 量化 Combine 接收数据、top-k/shared 累加与最终 y 写回的整体成本。
points.semantics: Unpermute buffer 已构造，即将进入本核 token range。
points.perturbation: 每个 AIV 一次时钟读取。

dependency.proof: marker immediately precedes UnpermuteTokens

points.scope: 与 unpermute_begin_S 一一对应。
points.why: 确认尾部慢点是否来自本地反量化/累加/写 y，而不是同步。
points.semantics: 本核负责 token 的最终 y MTE3 已全部完成。
points.perturbation: 每个 AIV 一次时钟读取，复用 UnpermuteTokens 的生产 MTE3_V drain。

dependency.proof: UnpermuteTokens consumes its outputBufferEvent after the final batch before return
